list.name: engine
list.label: Engine
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "instance", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "propulsion")

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "propulsion" and r._field == "revolutions" and r.instance == "${engine}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 60.0 }))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "propulsion" and r._field == "temperature" and r.instance == "${engine}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: (r._value - 273.15) * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0 }))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "propulsion" and r._field == "oilPressure" and r.instance == "${engine}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 6894.757 }))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "propulsion" and r._field == "fuel.rate" and r.instance == "${engine}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 3600.0 * 264.172 }))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical.batteries" and r._field == "voltage" and r.id == "house")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
